business_problem: replace siloed warehouse, Hadoop, and SAP systems that could not combine financial, IoT, and OT data fast enough for self-service analytics, drilling decisions, forecasting, and M&A integration.
solution_summary: Expand Energy standardized on Snowflake as the shared platform for business, IoT, and operational data across its shale operations, replacing a fragmented stack of legacy warehouse, HDFS, and SAP HANA systems. Data from business systems, SCADA feeds, well production, equipment telemetry, site details, and M&A source systems is centralized in Snowflake so engineers, finance teams, and field operations can work from a single governed foundation. Snowpark models and cloud-hosted machine learning workflows maintain dynamic well forecasts, while Cortex Analyst adds natural-language analysis over drilling activity and nonproductive time. Continuous Snowflake queries create digital-twin-style monitoring for 3,700 sites and surface anomalies such as corrosion, equipment risk, or downtime for the operations center. The same platform also co-locates data from acquired companies, accelerates cleansing and conversion, and enforces RBAC-based access, auditability, and regulatory reporting.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Centralizes financial, operational, IoT, and M&A data and runs the continuous queries that support monitoring and analytics.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Supports the data models and machine learning workflows used for well forecasting and real-time drilling analytics.

solution_components.name: Cortex Analyst
solution_components.role: Lets engineers ask natural-language questions about drilling activity and recent operations directly on Snowflake data.

solution_components.name: role-based access control (RBAC)
solution_components.role: Secures self-service access by aligning Snowflake permissions with data sensitivity, auditability, and regulatory requirements.

data_flow: Business systems, SCADA feeds, well production data, equipment age, and site details land in Snowflake. Snowpark models and ML workflows maintain forecasts and drilling datasets, while continuous queries generate digital-twin-style monitoring and alerts for corrosion or downtime risk. Cortex Analyst serves natural-language answers to engineers, and the same governed platform co-locates acquired-company data for finance and accounting integration.
business_outcome: Expand Energy cut data-related M&A time and cost by 40%, saves more than 1,000 labor hours per year in one business unit, and gives engineers and operators faster self-service insight for forecasting, drilling, safety, and regulatory work.
